title: Route/Model/Region latency explorer and p95-p99 regression detection
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an exploratory and alerting surface that surfaces p95 and p99 latency broken down by route, model, and region alongside tokens/sec throughput. This ticket covers backend rollups, regression detection logic, and a Grafana dashboard + drilldown panels. Focus is on stable aggregation at high cardinality without exploding storage costs and on deterministic regression alerts for CI and production smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Grafana dashboard that shows p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per combination of {route, model, region} for sliding windows (5m, 1h, 24h, 30d)
Dashboards support filtering and table view with sortable columns and a link to historical baseline comparisons (7d/30d)

Automated regression detector that signals when p95 or p99 increases by >15% from a rolling baseline for at least 30 minutes (configurable), with a corresponding alert and ticket stub created in the monitoring queue
Throughput (tokens/sec and requests/sec) correlated on the same panels to help identify load vs. performance regressions
Rollup jobs that pre-aggregate high-cardinality keys hourly and keep 30d of detailed metrics, older data summarized to 90d to control cost
Dashboard query examples and panels reviewed and approved by SRE and Performance PM
Unit/integration tests for regression detector logic with simulated traffic profiles included in the regression harness
implementation_plan: Schema: add metrics tags route, model_version, region, and a cardinality label 'route_generic' for grouping heavy-cardinality routes
Backend: implement hourly rollup job in metrics-worker that computes p50/95/99 and tokens/sec per tag set and writes to metrics-store (use quantile-approx algorithm currently used in runtime)
Regression detector service (python) that consumes rollups and maintains EWMA-based baseline per key; emits alerts to Alertmanager when threshold crossed
Dashboard: create Grafana folder 'Latency Explorer (route/model/region)' with overview + drilldown row panels and a table with sparkline per key
CI: extend load/regression harness to emit synthetic traces for edge models and ensure the detector flags injected regressions
Cost control: add TTL rules and compacted retention for high-cardinality keys; add cardinality cap with sampling fallback
Release: feature-flag dashboard and detector in staging, enable for 10% of routes initially
testing_plan: Local: run load-harness profiles (small/median/heavy) against staging runtime and verify rollup metrics appear in metrics-store
Simulated regressions: introduce 20% added latency to a model in staging and verify detector fires within configured window
Throughput correlation: generate traffic spikes and ensure tokens/sec scaling appears on same timeframe as latency changes
Regression test: add unit tests for EWMA baseline computation, and end-to-end integration test that uses harness to create a regression and expects an Alertmanager webhook
Performance: validate that hourly rollups for 50k distinct keys complete within the 10-minute job window under current cluster sizing
dashboard_queries: PromQL (p95, 5m): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="staging"}[5m])) by (le, route, model, region))
Rollup query (daily): topk(100, increase(metrics_rollup_p95_count[24h]) ) by (route, model, region)
Alerting rule example (p95 regression): (p95_current / p95_baseline) > 1.15 and p95_current > 0.1 (seconds) for 30m
Baseline computation (example): p95_baseline = EWMA(p95_rollup, alpha=0.2) with decay window 7d
load_profiles: light: 50 rps distributed across 10 routes, median seq_len 128 tokens
typical: 500 rps targeting top 20 routes, mix of models (small/medium), median seq_len 256
stress: 5k rps with long-sequence tail, synthetic burst pattern (1m on / 4m off) to test autoscaling impact
regression-injection: same as typical but with injected 20-40% CPU-bound delay in model runner to validate detector
comments: 2026-03-08 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes: prioritize p95 and p99, need SRE input on retention/cost. Agreed on EWMA baseline as first pass.
2026-03-09 - Devon Chang: Implemented initial rollup job prototype and pushed to staging PR #4276. Observed 18% CPU increase on metrics-worker when run against full staging traffic.
2026-03-10 - Priya Shah (SRE): Reviewed rollup approach. Concern: per-route cardinality could explode; recommend route_generic tag and sample fallback for low-volume routes.
2026-03-11 - Devon Chang: Added Grafana mockups and query templates. Need product signoff on alert thresholds and on-table drilldown UX.
2026-03-12 - Marco Rivera (Perf PM): Agreed on alert: 15% p95/p99 increase sustained 30m. Also requested tokens/sec correlation panel and a summary KPI row for SLA customers.
notes: We should instrument the regression detector with metadata about whether the regression is capture-only (no alert) for CI runs vs. production runs. Consider exporting anomaly scores to the Console's Rollouts UI so engineers can see regressions tied to deploys.
implementation_risks: High cardinality growth if route/model tagging is too granular
Rollup job could become a bottleneck at scale if not parallelized or if quantile algorithm is too expensive
False positives from detector during autoscaling events unless tokens/sec correlation is considered
